verdict.rationale: Base44 supports iterative AI-driven editing (chat-to-build, design previews before changes, whiteboard notes sent to AI) and comm-1/comm-2 show users iterating with follow-up prompts to get functional apps, but there's no direct evidence addressing regression-safety across iterations, and comm-6 suggests users can 'hit a wall' iterating without clear resolution. missing for 10: explicit documentation or testimony that follow-up prompts preserve prior functionality/no regressions, version history or rollback safeguards during iteration, and independent hands-on confirmation of non-breaking edits.
